references.text: The preceding context describing how the kings gathered against Israel, leading directly to verse 5 where they meet at the waters of Merom.
A similar alliance of kings who gathered against Gibeon, illustrating a pattern of Canaanite coalitions against Israel.
Sisera gathered his chariots by the Kishon River, a similar military assembly against Israel in the same geographical area.
"The kings of the earth rise up and the rulers band together against the Lord and against his anointed" - a prophetic theme about nations gathering against God's people.
The outcome of this battle at the waters of Merom, where the Lord gave the enemies into Israel's hand.
The Ammonites camped against Israel, a similar situation where enemies gathered for war against God's people.
